fusions.name: Feed on Rot
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fruiting Burst
fusions.desc: A burst of spores that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Mat of Threads
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of mycelium where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow Rot
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
